title: Acceptance bit
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet and Boolean lists $x$ and $l$, the acceptance bit is true exactly when $N$ accepts input $x$ using choice sequence $l$; otherwise it is false.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
